As {{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-clone-wars-chronological-episodeorder|text=''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Chronological Episode Order}} establishes that the episode "[[Ambush]]," which depicts the [[B1-series battle droid]]'s [[death]] on [[Rugosa]], takes place chronologically between these two episodes, it must also take place in 22 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]]. |creator= |manufacturer= |line=[[B-series battle droid]]{{TCW|Ambush}} |model=[[B1-series battle droid]] |class=[[Battle droid]] |cost= |length= |width= |height= |mass= |gender= |pronouns= |sensor= |plating= |armament=[[E-5 blaster rifle]] |equipment= |affiliation=*[[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] **[[Separatist Droid Army]] }} {{Quote|Where is 224?''"
"''Destroyed, supreme leader. The Jedi has overrun our position and...|This droid responding to Asajj Ventress.|}} A '''B1 battle droid''' served in the [[Separatist Droid Army]] during the [[Clone Wars]]. In [[22 BBY]], it was among the forces deployed to the [[moon]] [[Rugosa]] to try and prevent [[Jedi]] [[Grand Master]] [[Yoda]] from [[Battle of Rugosa|negotiating]] with [[Toydarian]] [[King]] [[Katuunko]] for the [[planet]] [[Toydaria]] to join the [[Galactic Republic]]. After the [[OOM-series battle droid]] [[224]] was [[Death|destroyed]] by Yoda, the [[battle droid]] reported 224's demise to [[Asajj Ventress]], commander of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist]] forces on the moon, via [[hologram]]. The [[droid]] was then also destroyed by the Jedi. {{Char-stub}} ==Appearances== *{{TCW|Ambush}} {{1st}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} [[Category:B1-series battle droids]] [[Category:Droids of the Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[Category:Droids with unspecified gender programming]] [[Category:Droids with unspecified pronouns]]
